subject: Physics
source_note: External demand evidence from NEETPrep Mini Q Bank - Motion in a Plane, Relative Motion filter. Text-visible questions that now map to canonical capabilities are included. External questions remain transient and are not promoted to Core2/source custody.

questions.note: Walking observer with vertical rain; requires relative velocity as a vector and perpendicular-component magnitude.
Boat and water velocities are both given in the ground frame; learner must subtract in the correct observer order.
Symbolic rain-versus-runner version of perpendicular relative-velocity magnitude.
Perpendicular chase/intercept geometry; relative frame plus right-triangle relation is required to obtain catch time.
River crossing directly opposite: compose swimmer-relative-water and water-relative-ground velocities, choose the along-river swimmer component so the ground-relative along-river component cancels.
Shortest-path river crossing: impose the perpendicular-resultant constraint, compose signed components, and use the right-triangle relation if a magnitude relation is requested.
